show.description: When struggling IIT student Vikram Raghuvanshi accepts a mysterious offer from powerful businessman Rajveer Mehra, his life takes an unexpected turn. Bound by a deal to marry Rajveer’s arrogant daughter Devanshi, Vikram is thrown into a world of power, deceit, and heartbreak. What begins as a contract soon spirals into a storm of betrayal, sacrifice, and redemption ending with one final, unforgettable goodbye.
